args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 3 flagged, 5 cleared.
Flagged, summary_outlier: r05. Its centre REGR peak is 52.89 %/h (batch median 0.37), its growth zone is 695 µm (median 42) and its largest flank difference is -9.88 %/h (median 0.55). The differences are too large to come from a faster root.
Flagged, summary_outlier: r06 and r08. Their profile has a different shape. The largest flank difference sits at 84 µm (median 316 µm, z -5.05) and is negative (-0.47 %/h). Their centre REGR peak is about twice the batch value (0.72 %/h).
Cleared: r01, r02, r03, r04, r07. All checks pass, they kept no remedies, had no roll backs, and every summary has |z| ≤ 1.42.
What the flagged runs share: all three kinematic checks pass, with no remedies and no roll backs. The fault shows only in the strain-rate and curvature profile summaries, so passing checks alone did not catch it. r05 has exactly the same check values as r01, r03 and r07, but very different summaries. This points to a scaling or processing problem in the strain-rate profile, not in tracking. Several runs also have identical values (r01, r03 and r07; r02 and r04; r06 and r08). It's worth checking whether these are duplicate measurements of the same movie.
